title: Generalization of Navascués' $α$-fractal operator on lifted Sierpiński gasket
summary: The primary objective of the present article is to extend Navascués' class of $α$-fractal interpolation functions ($α$-FIFs) from a Euclidean domain to a non-Euclidean domain. Precisely, we consider the lifted Sierpiński gasket $\big(\widetilde{SG}\big)$, which is a subset of the first Heisenberg group equipped with a \textit{non-Euclidean metric} (popularly known as the Heisenberg metric), and demonstrate the existence of the class of $α$-FIFs in the continuous space on $\widetilde{SG}$.
